name: fixture_fingerprint
description: Records the data and service versions (s1, folded). fixture_fingerprint@1, read-only.

inputSchema.description: No input: s1 always reads the same four sources.

name: cohort_count
description: Counts the cases a Gen3 filter matches. cohort_count@1, read-only.

filter.description: The Gen3 filter to count, `and`-wrapped; a filtered scope arrives as its case-ID clause (C-23).

name: cases_query
description: Lists the case IDs a Gen3 filter matches, in pages of 1,000. cases_query@1, read-only.

filter.description: The Gen3 filter whose case IDs to list, `and`-wrapped.

pageSize.description: Sent as `size`; pages are read at offsets 0, page_size, ... while offset + size <= max_ids.

maxIds.description: The most case IDs the step may return (C-GUARD); more is TOO_MANY_IDS.

name: gene_cases
description: Lists the cases with a mutation in one panel gene. gene_cases@1, read-only.

gene.description: The panel gene; its Ensembl id goes in gene_filter (PANEL_GENE_IDS). One of: "KRAS", "NRAS", "TP53", "BRAF", "DIS3", "MYC".

cohortFilter.description: Sent as cohort_filter: the scope's filter, `{"and": []}` for all cases.

name: top_mutated_genes
description: Ranks a cohort's genes by mutated cases, as OncoMatrix does. top_mutated_genes@1, read-only.

filter0.description: The cohort as Gen3 filter0 (a case-ID list, C-CASEIDS); null for all cases. Pinned as the card's filter0.

geneCount.description: How many genes the card shows: top N (sent as maxGenes = geneCount + 1, the extra row only detects a tie).

name: survival_compare
description: Kaplan–Meier curves per group and the log-rank p. survival_compare@1, read-only.

inputSchema.description: Exactly what derive_request_pinned("survival") reads: scope, term and split {field, overlay}.

scope.description: The scope as Gen3 filter (the scope step's case-ID clause); null for all cases. The card's filter0.

term.description: The survival term; Gen3 Analysis' default survivalType "overall" (the body sends none). Always "overall_survival".

split.description: The split field and its twin; null when the groups are cohorts with no twin (no survival card).

field.description: The vocabulary field the groups split (C-SPLIT), such as cgs_risk_key_criteria.cgs_risk_category.

overlay.description: That field's ProteinPaint twin term id (vocab proteinpaintTwins), the chart's overlay term.

label.description: The group's display label: the split value, or the cohort's label.

filter.description: The group's complete Gen3 filter, the scope included; sent alone, then with the others.

name: sample_lists
description: Maps both DE groups' case IDs to ProteinPaint samples. sample_lists@1, read-only.

key.description: control (DE group 1) or case (DE group 2). One of: "control", "case".

caseIds.description: The group's case IDs, sent as filter0 = case_id_filter(caseIds).

name: de_preanalysis
description: Counts RNA-seq-eligible samples per group, before any save. de_preanalysis@1, read-only.

key.description: Also the samplelst group name sent, so pre-analysis never depends on a cohort's name. One of: "control", "case".

sampleIds.description: The group's ProteinPaint sample ids (sample_lists), sent as samplelst values [{sampleId}].

name: de_run
description: Runs differential expression with the viewer's own request body. de_run@1, read-only.

items.description: One DE group, as derive_request_pinned reads it: name and sampleIds, plus cohortId and filter0 once saved.

name.description: The read-back saved name after Create, else the proposed name (C-24): part of ProteinPaint's DE cache key.

sampleIds.description: The group's sample ids in sample_lists' order (ascending), sent as samplelst values.

cohortId.description: The read-back cohort id, present only once the cohort is saved or reused (deInput).

filter0.description: The saved cohort's case-ID filter (case_id_filter), present with cohortId (deInput).

thresholds.description: Sent as volcanoRender.significanceThresholds (pValueCutoff as -log10); absent keeps the viewer's.
